main_text.p: In nuptijs lautè vestiti, exornatiqúe erant: & candidè incedebant cum coronâ & lampade. Cas. 2.8.v.10. & 4.1.v.9. & 4.2.v.17. & 4.4.v.26.
In nuptijs hilariter vivendum. Quod & avarus agnovit Euclio. Aul. 2.8.v.1.
In eloc andis liberis familiæ non postrema semper habita ratio. Trin. 5.2.v.9.
main_text.head: NUTRICUM.
main_text.p: NUTRICES à pueris variè maculantur. Unde in Proverbio Nutricis Pallium.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament below the Nutricum entry, not transcribed. The large initial N of NUTRICES is a decorative woodcut letter. The entry "In elocandis" is printed as "elocandis" in the scan; read as printed.
